package.name: go2_cmd_bridge
package.description: Turns a geometry_msgs/Twist stream on /go2/cmd_vel into streamed Move requests for the Unitree Go2, with clamps, a watchdog, thermal/speed/geofence aborts and a handset yield. ⛔ CAN PUBLISH TO THE ROBOT when armed. Kept out of go2_adapter on purpose: read-only and write-capable code never share a package. Audited by scripts/test_cmd_bridge_offline.py. Plan: gate7_go2_cmdvel_bridge_plan.md.
